verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents one built-in recurring scheduled automation: Automatic Check-ins, which ask the team questions on a set schedule (e.g., every Monday at 9am) and collect the answers. That is a real recurring schedule run by the product itself, not a one-off action, but it is limited to check-in questions rather than general jobs or workflows. The API, CLI and MCP support are only building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: general-purpose recurring job/workflow scheduling, recurring to-dos or task automation, scheduling triggerable by AI agents, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Basecamp asks your team questions on a schedule, like “What are you working on this week?” every Monday at 9am, and saves everyone’s answers in one place.
Cut back on meetings by setting up Automatic Check-ins.
